releaseNotes:
1. Critical Span Crossings GIS Map Layer: Dedicated Crossings Layer rendering all verified & finalized highway, railway, river, and power line span crossings with category colors, high-contrast badges, and span highlights.
2. Robust Waypoint & Feeder Matching: Fixed span crossings (e.g. River at Loc.134-135 and Road at Loc.136-137) by implementing multi-level feeder name normalization (handling DC circuit variations like 'I & II' vs 'I'/'II' and Tamil translations) and resilient tower identifier matching ('Loc.134' vs '134').
3. Streamlined Map UI: Removed redundant floating screen toggle pill in favor of the clean autohide right-hand toolbar button and GIS Layer Manager.
4. Centralized Common Report Design System: Enforced TANTRANSCO corporate styling across PDF, High-Res JPEG, and OpenXML Excel (.xlsx) with strict Division/Section header rules and zero approval blocks.
5. Splash Screen Correction: Fully eliminated native white flash and hardcoded paths; logo loaded centrally from assets/icon.png with consistent #137C8B background.

previousStableRelease.releaseNotes: OTA Release v1.0.32 with restored v1.0.25 Crossings module architecture.
